title: CRLR/103/2013 of Sanjeev Kukreja Vs State Of Uttarakhand AND ANOTHER

paras.text:
CRLR No. 103 of 2013
Hon'ble Alok Singh, J.
Mr. Parikshit Saini, Advocate for the
revisionist.
Ms. Mamta Joshi, Brief Holder for the State
of Uttarakhand / respondent no. 1.
Mr. Rajendra Singh, Advocate for the
respondent no. 2.
Learned counsel for the parties fairly
submitted that matter has been settled amicably
between the parties; revisionist has paid
Rs. Twelve Lakh to the complainant; and now,
complainant is not interested in conviction of the
revisionist.
Since matter has been settled amicably
between the parties, therefore, revision is allowed.
Impugned judgments and orders are hereby set
aside. Complaint under Section 138 of the NI Act
is hereby dismissed.
Both the CRMA Nos. 1501 and 1608 of
2015 also stand disposed of accordingly.
 (Alok Singh, J.) 05.10.2015
SKS
